name: Tax Alchemy
category: Business and real estate tax planning
summary: Tax Alchemy offers strategic tax planning for business owners and real estate investors, with entity structuring, year-round advice, and flat-rate engagement pricing. Its public service model includes personalized advisory rather than education alone.
fit: Business owners or investors comparing a named tax strategy team, implementation responsibilities, and the complete cost of a planning engagement.
question: Which strategies, implementation tasks, and individual or business returns are included in the proposal?
decision: Compare the actual advisory engagement rather than the size of the firm's educational audience. A course, a planning project, and a return-filing service have different deliverables. Request the assigned professionals and the timetable for completing each recommended action.

name: Hall CPA (The Real Estate CPA)
category: Business and real estate tax planning
summary: Hall CPA, operating The Real Estate CPA website, markets tax planning for real estate investors, high-income earners, business owners, syndicators, and developers. Its public materials discuss entity structuring, depreciation, cost segregation, and real estate accounting.
fit: Rental owners and investors who need tax strategy connected to property operations, or sponsors with real estate partnership and reporting needs.
question: Who coordinates the property study, partnership reporting, and the owner's personal tax return?
decision: A syndicator's accounting needs can differ substantially from those of a physician buying a single rental. Compare the team's experience with your ownership structure and ask how business income, rental activity, and investor reporting will be coordinated.

name: Keystone CPA
category: Business and real estate tax planning
summary: Keystone CPA serves investors and business owners nationwide. Its homepage describes an initial review of income, businesses, entities, investments, and real estate, followed by a written tax plan with strategies and implementation steps.
fit: Investors and business owners seeking a written plan spanning their entities and real estate holdings.
question: Which implementation steps are performed by the firm, and which require the client or an outside professional?
decision: Use the written plan to compare the two firms. Ask for deliverables, execution deadlines, and responsibility for filings rather than comparing lists of possible deductions. An investor with multiple entities should establish who coordinates the full return package.

name: Taxstra
category: Business and real estate tax planning
summary: Taxstra is a Springfield, Illinois CPA firm serving clients nationwide. It lists strategic tax planning, tax preparation, bookkeeping, payroll, IRS representation, and specialized consulting for real estate investors, physicians, and business owners.
fit: Physicians, rental investors, and business owners seeking tax planning alongside preparation and ongoing accounting.
question: How will the team coordinate physician income, business compensation, and rental depreciation in one projection?
decision: A physician with 1099 income and rentals has overlapping decisions about compensation, estimated payments, retirement contributions, and property deductions. Compare a coordinated projection and the person responsible for each filing. Bookkeeping support may also matter when business records need cleanup before planning.

name: Anomaly CPA
category: Business and real estate tax planning
summary: Anomaly CPA is a nationwide virtual firm serving startups, growing businesses, and real estate investors. Its listed services combine cloud accounting and monthly close with tax preparation and strategy involving QSBS, R&D credits, multi-state issues, and real estate planning.
fit: Growing businesses or investors that need proactive tax work together with accounting, reporting, or startup finance support.
question: Does the quote include monthly close and investor reporting, or a separate tax strategy project?
decision: A venture-backed founder may need accrual accounting and diligence-ready financial statements in addition to personal tax advice. An owner-operated business may prioritize compensation and real estate planning instead. Compare the finance infrastructure you actually need with the tax work being purchased.

name: Advise RE
category: Business and real estate tax planning
summary: Advise RE markets year-round tax advisory and CPA services for real estate investors and developers. Its site connects planning and preparation with depreciation, 1031 exchanges, and entity structure, and also lists construction and buyer advisory services.
fit: Property owners and developers seeking a real estate-focused planning and preparation relationship.
question: Does the engagement cover the investment purchase or development decision before closing, as well as the subsequent returns?
decision: A development project can require construction and transaction advice that differs from annual rental tax preparation. Compare when each team enters the process, what records it reviews before closing, and how property decisions connect with the owner's other business income.

name: WCG CPAs & Advisors
category: Business and real estate tax planning
summary: WCG CPAs & Advisors lists small business advisory, S corporation elections, reasonable compensation, tax planning, accounting, payroll, rental property consulting, and multi-state tax work. The firm publishes fee ranges and describes customized service packages.
fit: S corporation owners and rental investors comparing ongoing accounting and tax planning packages.
question: Which owner-compensation analysis, payroll work, and real estate review are included in the selected package?
decision: For an S corporation owner, compare the compensation model and payroll responsibilities as well as the return price. If rentals sit alongside the operating business, establish whether the package reviews both activities or only the business. Published packages still need a scope matched to your entity count.

name: Tax Goddess
category: Business and real estate tax planning
summary: Tax Goddess Business Services markets strategic tax coaching and tax strategy programs for business leaders, professionals, and entrepreneurs. Its homepage distinguishes programs for different business sizes and emphasizes clients with substantial annual tax bills.
fit: Profitable business owners comparing a strategy-focused engagement and the support required to implement it.
question: What specific actions, documentation, and filing responsibilities are included in the selected strategy program?
decision: Evaluate the proposed strategies against your facts and the work required to execute them. A marketing savings example does not establish your own outcome. Ask for the planning assumptions, assigned professional, implementation calendar, and total fee before comparing the program with an AE engagement.

name: Tax Saving Experts
category: Business and real estate tax planning
summary: Tax Saving Experts lists tax strategies, cost segregation studies, real estate professional status guidance, coaching, and recordkeeping. Its CFO package describes tax preparation and filing, bookkeeping, reconciliation, payroll, and yearly tax strategies.
fit: Business owners and property investors comparing strategy, cost segregation, and an optional broader accounting package.
question: Are property sourcing, study work, tax advice, and recurring accounting separate services with separate fees?
decision: A rental acquisition and a tax advisory engagement should be evaluated on their own economics. If you are considering property sourcing alongside tax services, identify the contracting parties and compensation arrangements. Compare who documents eligibility for proposed deductions and who completes the affected returns.

name: Incite Tax
category: Tax strategy with accounting support
summary: Incite Tax & Accounting serves business owners nationwide from Utah. Its public offerings include proactive tax planning, bookkeeping, Profit First cash management, CFO consulting, and IRS tax resolution.
fit: Owner-operated businesses seeking tax planning together with cash management, bookkeeping, and CFO guidance.
question: Will one engagement cover bookkeeping and cash management as well as tax planning, or are they separate packages?
decision: When profit and cash visibility are the primary problem, compare the monthly financial work alongside the tax plan. A business with clean books but a major tax transaction may need a narrower engagement. Ask whether historical cleanup, management reporting, and IRS case work are included.

name: Peter Holtz CPA
category: Tax strategy with accounting support
summary: Peter Holtz CPA combines timely accounting, proactive tax strategy, profit consulting, CFO advisory, and IRS representation. Its website states that clients generate at least $1 million in revenue and describes an integrated business financial advisory model.
fit: Established business owners comparing tax planning as part of a broader accounting and CFO relationship.
question: What does the financial advisory relationship add beyond the tax plan and annual filings?
decision: Compare reporting cadence, management advice, and the decisions your owner or finance team needs help making. An integrated CFO relationship may be useful when reliable financial information is missing. If the main issue is prior-year tax work or a rental purchase, ask for those deliverables explicitly.

name: Rainwater CPA
category: Tax strategy with accounting support
summary: Rainwater CPA markets business tax advisory for seven- and eight-figure business owners. Its public service description includes quarterly projections, four planning meetings per year, tax preparation and filing, and tax resolution services.
fit: Established business owners seeking scheduled projections and planning connected with annual preparation.
question: How are quarterly projections updated when a purchase, new entity, or major compensation change occurs?
decision: Compare a scheduled planning relationship with the specific work needed before a business decision. Ask how urgent events between meetings are handled and which records keep projections current. If rentals or depreciation changes are part of your situation, include them in the requested scope.

name: Dark Horse CPAs
category: Tax strategy with accounting support
summary: Dark Horse CPAs markets tax advisory and compliance, accounting, and business financial support. Its public tax materials describe planning with a CPA and expertise including rental properties, stock compensation, 1031 exchanges, and multi-state filings.
fit: Business owners seeking a CPA relationship that combines tax planning with accounting or broader financial guidance.
question: Which CPA will own the relationship, and what planning, accounting, and CFO work will that person deliver?
decision: A broad firm can offer many specialties, but your assigned professional and engagement scope determine the service you receive. Compare the actual CPA's experience with your business and rentals, the reporting schedule, and how projections feed management decisions. Ask for a distinct price for accounting, advisory, and return preparation.

name: Gelt
category: Tax strategy with accounting support
summary: Gelt offers year-round tax strategy, compliance, and a tax management platform. It lists business and individual filing services and separately scoped strategy plans, with industry pages for healthcare, technology, professional services, and real estate investors.
fit: Business owners and investors who want planning and compliance coordinated through a tax management platform.
question: Which strategy services are included beyond compliance, and which are separately scoped projects?
decision: Compare the professional service delivered through the platform rather than the dashboard alone. Ask how projections are reviewed, which entities are covered, and how implementation is assigned. Where published compliance and strategy prices are separate, add them before comparing first-year cost.

name: Jasmine DiLucci / DiLucci CPA Firm
category: Tax strategy with accounting support
summary: DiLucci CPA Firm lists tax planning and preparation, bookkeeping, and IRS tax resolution. Its site identifies Jasmine DiLucci as an attorney, CPA, and enrolled agent and presents services for business tax and accounting needs.
fit: Business owners comparing tax planning with bookkeeping or an existing IRS resolution need.
question: Will the same engagement cover the IRS matter, ongoing books, and forward-looking planning?
decision: If an IRS notice or collection issue is driving the search, compare the professional assigned to that case and the representation scope. Future planning and historical resolution may require different projects. An owner with rentals should also identify who reviews depreciation and coordinates the related returns.

name: Pronto Advisors
category: Tax strategy with accounting support
summary: Pronto Advisors markets tax advisory, accounting and bookkeeping, payroll, and business formation for real estate investors, business owners, and entrepreneurs. It says it can work alongside an existing team or take over the broader relationship.
fit: Business owners and investors seeking tax strategy connected to routine accounting and payroll.
question: Can the proposed tax advisory scope work with the current bookkeeper and preparer, or does it require a full transfer?
decision: A full accounting transition can be useful when financial data is unreliable, but a business with a functioning team may prefer a planning project. Compare the handoff process, responsibility for payroll and filings, and how the advisory work uses monthly records. Specify who retains historical files.

name: Fluency Tax
category: Business and real estate tax planning
summary: Fluency Tax describes a boutique practice for profitable solopreneurs, S corporations, and real estate investors. Its services include a return diagnostic, written tax playbooks, S corporation transitions, real estate strategy, compliance, and advisory retainers.
fit: Profitable Schedule C or S corporation owners and rental investors who want direct strategy and execution support.
question: Does the firm accept every entity in the ownership group, particularly partnerships or C corporations?
decision: Fluency's public fit criteria exclude multi-member partnerships and C corporations, so an owner with those entities should resolve that limitation before comparing fees. For an eligible S corporation, ask how elections, compensation, payroll setup, written playbooks, and returns are coordinated. Compare optional ongoing retainers separately.

name: Proactive Tax Advisors
category: Business and real estate tax planning
summary: Proactive Tax Advisors markets strategic planning for high-income service-based business owners and real estate investors. Its process includes an assessment, personalized tax strategy plan, implementation support at a chosen level, and optional ongoing optimization.
fit: Service-business owners and investors seeking a planning project with a choice of implementation support.
question: Which implementation level is quoted, and who completes each action if the client chooses self-guided support?
decision: Compare a plan-only scope with a coordinated implementation scope before deciding which price is lower. An owner who lacks time or a reliable preparer may need more execution support. Ask which future reviews are optional and how changes in income or ownership are handled after the initial project.

name: Benficial CPA
category: Business and real estate tax planning
summary: Benficial CPA markets proactive real estate tax strategy for investors earning $250,000 or more. Its Los Angeles-based practice describes nationwide service and a planning process spanning property purchases, deductions, implementation, and eventual exits.
fit: High-income rental investors comparing a real estate tax plan covering acquisition through exit.
question: Who prepares the returns and study-related filings, and are those fees included in the plan?
decision: A property-focused planning relationship should account for the holding period and sale as well as the initial deduction. Compare assumptions about income, financing, participation, and implementation. Confirm return preparation responsibilities directly because a planning description does not establish every included filing.

name: ZCW CPAs
category: Business and real estate tax planning
summary: Zhubrak, Clark & Wasser CPAs markets tax and accounting for real estate investors, operators, syndicators, and general partners. Its public real estate page lists preparation, separately scoped planning, cost segregation and depreciation planning, bookkeeping, and fractional CFO services.
fit: Real estate operators and sponsors comparing tax strategy with accounting and investor reporting support.
question: Does the engagement include partnership returns and investor reporting in addition to the owner's planning?
decision: A sponsor raising capital needs reliable close and reporting processes that an individual rental owner may not need. Compare those accounting deliverables separately from tax strategy. For either profile, establish who owns the depreciation analysis and each business and individual return.

name: Cerebral Tax Advisors
category: Physician and private-client tax planning
summary: Cerebral Tax Advisors specializes in medical professionals and private practice physicians. Its public model emphasizes tax plan implementation, filing, and verification, including situations combining W-2 income, independent-contractor business income, and real estate.
fit: Physicians and healthcare practice owners seeking implementation support across medical income and investments.
question: Which medical-income and investment activities qualify for the selected package, and what execution work is included?
decision: A locum physician, a hospital employee with rentals, and a practice owner have different planning and accounting needs. Compare the package applicable to your profile, the professional access provided, and which filings are covered. If evaluating a savings guarantee, read its eligibility conditions and exclusions.

name: Prime Path Advisory
category: Physician and private-client tax planning
summary: Prime Path Advisory markets year-round tax strategy for founders, executives, and high-RSU earners making at least $1 million. Its public model describes strategy design, implementation, and filing with attorney and CPA coordination.
fit: High-income founders or executives comparing a private-client model with business and investment tax planning.
question: How does the engagement coordinate RSUs and executive compensation with outside businesses or rental property?
decision: This is a closer comparison for an executive with substantial equity income than for a small rental owner. Ask which professionals review compensation, entities, and real estate together, and whether the quoted scope covers each return. Confirm the firm's income qualification before investing time in proposals.

name: Neil Jesani Advisors
category: Physician and private-client tax planning
summary: Neil Jesani Advisors presents three practices: mid-market advisory, private-client services, and tax controversy. Its public focus includes successful businesses and ultra-high-income individuals, with strategic planning, CFO services, and audit defense.
fit: Owners facing a liquidity event, private-client complexity, or tax controversy alongside planning needs.
question: Is the proposed work a tax project, CFO engagement, controversy matter, or a combination with separate fees?
decision: The firm's broader private-client and mid-market focus may be relevant when a business sale or complex dispute is driving the search. Compare specialist assignments and engagement boundaries. A rental investor seeking a limited depreciation project should first confirm that the firm's intake and scope fit that need.

name: Bracket Tax Co.
category: Tax strategy with accounting support
summary: Bracket Tax Co. describes a CPA practice based in Asheville serving business owners and equity-compensated professionals nationwide. Its public positioning emphasizes proactive tax planning and a year-round advisory relationship, including equity compensation and ISO planning.
fit: Business owners or equity-compensated professionals seeking year-round CPA planning.
question: Does the proposed plan coordinate equity exercise decisions with business income and other investment activity?
decision: Bracket Tax Co. is distinct from Bracket Partners, the real estate incentive consulting firm. Match the correct provider to the decision. An owner with incentive stock options should compare scenario modeling and timing support; an owner primarily seeking rental depreciation should confirm that work in the proposed scope.

name: Anderson Business Advisors
category: Business and real estate tax planning
summary: Anderson Business Advisors lists tax planning, bookkeeping, entity formation and management, real estate asset protection, estate planning, and retirement services. Its public offerings include educational workshops and a Platinum membership alongside professional services.
fit: Business owners and investors comparing tax work with legal entity, estate, and asset-protection needs.
question: Which work is covered by membership, and which requires a separate tax or legal engagement?
decision: Legal formation, membership access, and tax return preparation are different purchases. Compare each separately and identify the contracting provider for the work you need. If you need legal documents alongside tax planning, establish the attorney's role and how the tax and legal teams coordinate implementation.

name: Pillar Advisors
category: Tax strategy with accounting support
summary: Pillar Advisors lists bookkeeping and reporting, tax compliance and advisory, financial controls, strategic finance, and capital structure advisory. Its website says it employs CPAs and tax experts while stating that Pillar Advisors is not a public accounting firm.
fit: Growing businesses seeking an integrated accounting and financial advisory partner that also provides tax support.
question: Who contracts for and signs the tax work, and which monthly accounting or finance services are required?
decision: Pillar's business finance scope is relevant when an owner needs books, controls, and forward-looking financial analysis as well as tax advice. Do not infer that every service is performed under a public accounting firm engagement. Request the tax signer's identity, contracting entity, and any assurance-service limitations.

name: Graphite Financial
category: Tax strategy with accounting support
summary: Graphite Financial lists federal and state tax compliance, real-time advisory, R&D credits, multi-state support, entity structure planning, and year-round tax guidance. Its company overview describes integrated accounting, controllership, forecasting, tax, payroll, and financial operations for growing and venture-backed companies.
fit: Growing or venture-backed companies comparing tax services as part of an outsourced finance function.
question: Is the objective investor-ready finance infrastructure, the owner's tax plan, or both?
decision: A company preparing for a funding round may prioritize financial reporting, forecasts, and multi-state compliance. A profitable founder with rentals may also need personal planning that crosses company boundaries. Ask whether the quote covers the founder's returns and investments, or only the operating company.

name: Tax Strategists of America
category: Business and real estate tax planning
summary: Tax Strategists of America describes gathering client data, implementing custom strategies, preparing supporting documentation, and providing a year-end summary for the client's accountant. Its official materials identify founder Carlotta Thompson as a former IRS agent.
fit: Business owners seeking strategy implementation while potentially retaining their existing return preparer.
question: Who incorporates the implemented strategies into the return, and how is the preparer's review documented?
decision: The public services page describes an accountant handoff, so compare that workflow with a scope that includes preparation. Keeping an existing preparer can work well if responsibilities are clear. Ask for the supporting records, reconciliation process, and person responsible for resolving any difference between the plan and the filed return.
